fact: The Kenya National Broadband Strategy 2025-2030, the third national strategy succeeding NBS 2018-2023, carries a Cabinet Secretary foreword and sets 2030 targets and a blended financing approach (Exchequer, Universal Service Fund, development finance), with the total cost left as 'KShs. Xxx billion' and annual reports, mid-term review and end-term evaluation planned.
title: Kenya National Broadband Strategy 2025-2030
publisher: Ministry of Information, Communications and the Digital Economy; Communications Authority of Kenya
